description: Welcome to your luxurious home away from home, perfectly situated in the heart of Paris, just a few minutes' away from Monceau Park, the Opera, and Champs Elysées.This stylish and contemporary apartment features 4 separate bedrooms, providing a peaceful retreat in the city. The open living area is perfect for unwinding, with 2 comfortable sofas and a dining table for enjoying meals at home.Ideal for up to 10 guests, this flat combines modern comforts with the timeless charm of Parisian living.The spacePerfectly located in chic Western Paris , just around the corner from the famous Monceau Parc Museum and a short walk from the Champs Elysées, this stylish 200sqm apartment located on the 1st floor up a building offers the perfect blend of comfort, charm, and convenience.
